record.question:
The 73rd Plenary Session of the North Eastern Council (NEC) was held in Shillong in June 2026.
    Which of the following is not a newly highlighted component of the Union Budget 2026 or the NEC
    Vision Plan 2047 strategy?
options: Development of integrated Buddhist circuits across Arunachal Pradesh, Sikkim, Assam, Manipur, Mizoram, and Tripura.
Deployment of a dedicated fleet of 4,000 e-buses connecting structural and civilizational Buddhist heritage sites in the NER.
Institutional restructuring of the NEC into an “Inter-State Resource Council” with legally binding judicial arbitration powers over inter-state land and forest disputes.
Aligning the UNATI scheme with tailored industrial incentives to spur manufacturing, handloom, and ancillary ecosystems.
